remaining_boundaries: Matching original policy/config/source identity and logical layout remain external prerequisites.
Fresh empty coordination files do not restore prior kernel flock ownership or provide multi-host fencing.
Selected backup integrity is not selected-generation freshness, current keeper journal or canonical chain truth.
Manifest pins need separate trusted/off-host handling; local hashes are not independent authentication.
After output final marker cleanup failure can leave an unapproved complete packet without successful returned pin; do not automatically adopt.
Advisory locks do not defend against hostile same-UID writers; exact-byte/identity rechecks bound observed races, not perpetual immutability.
Physical durability, filesystem/kernel stalls, host takeover, sustained operation, real notification channels and release acceptance are outside finite rehearsal.
No policy rewrite, signer material, service restart/adoption, timer initialization, clock reset, newest-folder fallback or deletion is provided.
